about: Yellowhead County is a municipal district in west-central Alberta along the Yellowhead Highway toward Jasper—not a city. Edson and Hinton sit as separate urban centres within a vast territory of foothills, forestry, and energy lease country. About 10,000 people live in Yellowhead County.
seoSummary: West-central Alberta municipal district along the Yellowhead—foothills forestry and energy country, not Edson or Hinton alone.
